Three-card monte.question: The _____ was Playing card scam.
Three-card monte.fact: Three-card monte – also called find the lady and three-card trick – is a confidence game in which the victims, or "marks", are tricked into betting a sum of money on the assumption that they can find the "money card" among three face-down playing cards.
